findings: Trunk branching and exposed roots reflect the approved reference more closely than samplev2.
Leaf groups remain fused into large faceted canopy plates; individual thin elliptical leaves from the reference are not faithfully reconstructed.
Bark texture is more detailed than samplev2 but still soft at extreme close range.
One mesh and material; no external GLB resources, validation passes.
Technical validity does not establish the requested visual quality.
review.recommendation: Retain useful trunk/branch structure and rebuild foliage as separate thin leaf meshes or masked foliage, rather than automatically paying for another whole-tree generation.
